data.name: Ikki
data.description:
Name: Ikki Kido
Height: 188 cm (6'2)
Weight: 92 (202 lbs)
Hair Color: Black
Eyes Color: Blue
Birthdate: August 15, 1997 (Age 25) (Leo)
Birthplace: Greece (He’s 1/2 Greek, 1/4 Japanese and 1/4 Russian)
Favorite Food: Hot Wings, Spaghetti with Red Sauce
Favorite Color: Orange
Favorite Works: 
Mobile Suit Gundam (Mainly UC Timeline stuff)
Other Geek Stuff (But he will deny he enjoys it)
Hobbies: Smoking, Drinking, Brooding of his past, doing work on engineering machines
Training Place:  Death Queen Island 
Dogma: Himself (Originally), His Family (Currently)
Armor: Cloth
Rank: Bronze Saint
Constellation: Phoenix 
Relatives:
Jun Kido (Father)
Partita Kido/Owl Partita (Mother)
Seika Kido/Crane Seika (Younger Sister)
Hyoga Kido/Cygnus Hyoga (Younger Brother)
Shiryu Kido/Dragon Shiryu (Younger Brother)
Seiya Kido/Pegasus Seiya (Younger Brother)
Shun Kido/Andromeda Shun (Younger Brother)
Mistumasa Kido (Paternal Grandfather)
Natassia Magnus (Maternal Grandmother)
Lavender Graad (Paternal Stepgrandmother)
Mei Kido/Coma Mei (Paternal Uncle)
Saori Kido/Athena (Adopted Paternal Aunt)
Esmeralda (Ex-Wife) (Deceased)
Unborn child (Son) (Deceased)

Past Lives
Bennu Kagaho (18th Century Life)

Personality: Ikki as a child was a innocent and kind boy, as he was curious and protective of his younger siblings. It changed when he and his family were forced to leave Greece to live in Japan. Despite of that, as a teenager he was a decent fella albeit a bit too serious. After the incident that put his father in a coma by accident at hands of Saori because of her godly cosmos. Ikki had enough, so he and his family decided to train to become Saints of Athena so they wouldn't be powerless anymore. He chew more than he could swallow however. As after 5 years of training he was a different person; Ikki's personality became hard, cold, aggressive.

All this is because Ikki was trained harshly and was instilled with the ideology that only hatred provides power, which seemed not to have influenced him much until he spared the life of his master Guilty (Esmeralda's father) , Esmeralda only person he fell in love with in his  years of training on Death Queen Island, she died at the hands of Guilty, her own father and her unborn child with her. Ikki's hatred  until then was locked in his being was released by such loss. However when he met the Virgo Gold Saint; Shaka, he became fearful as he dreaded the power of the Sanctuary and was worried about his siblings.

This attitude of fear and hatred was only maintained during the Black Saints Attack, after that he was only a serious, solitary character and although "aggressive" he no longer overflowed so much hatred and fear. 

Although he dislikes Saori for what she did to his father, he comes to forgive her and fight for her, not because she's his goddess but because she's his family. Ikki is a warrior who fights without holding back even when his enemy is a woman.

Although Ikki has many flaws, he feels great devotion and love towards his family, this is what gives him the strength to go on. He is a noble, complex and mature character, who does not hesitate every time it is necessary to sacrifice his life for his loved ones. (Even though he's immortal)

While im combat, Ikki's fighting style is aggressive and violent as he uses his flames and knives to attack, sometimes he screams at top of his lungs while charging against an enemy but he can also use his Phoenix Genma Ken to get information. Because he was in Death Queen Island, a hell on Earth. He saw rape, slavery, cannibalism, amoung other messed up stuff that made him jaded and cynical about humanity. Despite of seeing the worst of human kind he still fights for Earth, as on his own words "It's home, even if it's a shithole". Also he swears like a sailor.

Apperance: Ikki is a tall, buff, muscular man, 
he has long black hair with his bangs brushed back and tied on a low ponytail using a red league. He has eyes and a perpendicular scar that goes from his the temple of his nose to his left cheek, as a result of having dodged the blow that his former master threw at him and with which he ended up killing Esmeralda.  His civilian attire consists of a grey tank top, jeans pants,  brown combat boots and white bandages on both arms.


Phoenix Cloth: When he wears his Phoenix Cloth, he wears a black skin tight body suit that it’s like a second layer of skin and covers his entire body except his head.
For the Armor he wears a white armor consisting of a white Battle mask with headphones, a trident-like crest on the forehead with orange edges, a black polarized visor that shows white “eyes”, a faceplate that covers his face. A white chest plate with  shoulder pads that connect to his pectorals, white bracelet that covers his fore arms, a white utility belt with a orange belt buckle and two big pockets in each side, finally metallic boots that reaches to his thighs that have orange and behind him he has 3 orange Phoenix Tails consisted of metallic feathers that start from his back. On his chest there’s large symbol of a Phoenix in Orange color.

Extra Info of the Phoenix Cloth: This Cloth is an exception among the 88 armors of Athena. It is also said that it has never been worn by anyone before Ikki. It is also the most difficult to obtain since the training to become the holy phoenix is the most inhumane. Ikki received the worst treatment, and the most difficult of training on the Isle of the Death Queen, home to renegades and black armor makers, mostly copies of the phoenix armor.  Despite belonging to the lowest rank of the armors, it's been known by many Saints as "the most powerful Cloth" due to the fact that no blood is needed to revive it, as the Phoenix Cloth can rebuild on it's own, as even Gold Cloths do not possess this ability. 



Bio: He’s the Phoenix Saint of Athena of the 21st Century, and the first Phoenix Saint of all time.  Ikki was born as the first child of Jun Kido and Partita. He’s the older brother of Seika, Hyoga, Shiryu, Seiya and Shun. He’s also the Reincarnation of Bennu Kagaho, an Specter of Hades in the 18th Century 

Powers and Abilities
-Keen Intellect: Despite of his rough personality, he's quite smart as he can understand what his father and younger brother Hyoga say about science (he even corrected some of Hyoga's notes), but he hides it. 
Cosmos:
-Superhuman Statistics (Strength, Speed, Duarability, Reflexes, Stamina)
-Matter Manipulation (Can destroy the atoms of an object with his cosmo energy)
-Enhanced 5 Senses (Can see at great distance, great hearing, keen smell, etc)
-6th Sense (Psychokinesis, as allows him to have Extrasensory Perception; allows him to sense the life force of others. Resistance to Mind Attacks such as illusions and hallucinations)
-7th Sense (Allows him to move at the speed of light (300,000 km/s) and create miracles that allows him to make a possible outcome.)
-Immortality (Simply put: He can't be killed by any means. As he can be mutilated, melted down, destroy all his atoms into ashes yet he will regenerate anyways. The concept of Death Doesn't Exist to him. Not even his soul can be destroyed. He can exploit this as he can be a sponge damage or when his limbs are destroyed he can shock the enemy by regenerate)
-Weaponry Mastery (He can be capable in any weapon. His weapon of choice are knives, specially the feather knives of the tails of his Cloth. As he can use them for throwing or as weapons and he can channel his fiery cosmos to heat them and make them slice anything like a hot knife slicing butter)

Special Moves
Hoo Yoku Tensho:  Ikki concentrates his Cosmos, the aura that surrounds his assuming the shape of a fiery phoenix. Then, he pushes his palms forwards, producing a tremendous whirlwind and releasing his cosmos as a burning wave that engulfs his opponent. He can also turn it into an orange beam of energy.

Phoenix Genma Ken: A mental attack. Ikki focuses his Cosmos, he becomes intangible for some moments as phases trough the enemy and pierces the opponent's mind with a swift punch. While the external pain is insignificant, comparable to a mosquito's bite, the internal pain is unbearable. Ikki's opponent is trapped in hellish illusions, where he is exposed to his deepest fears and constant torturous death. Ikki can also use it to get information of the victim's memories, as in case that interrogation doesn't work. At a minimum, the attack will leave its victim dazed and incapable of reacting; at worst, it will literally destroy their minds. This attack affects mind and soul of the opponent 

Fire Manipulation: He can manipulate fire in various ways as possible, as he can make potent fireballs or flames hot enough to harm even ice that reaches the Absolute zero temperatures, because of his keen intellect, Ikki knows what to do to cause a spark. His fire is so hot that even Gold Cloths, armors bathed in Sunlight, can be overheated.

entries.name: Cosmos
entries.content:
It is a mystical energy and the fundamental force which powers every supernatural feat performed throughout the series. The origins of Cosmo can be traced back to the Big Bang, which from the entirety of the universe was born. All living beings possess Cosmo deep within them. While normally unaware of it, over Time, beings such as humans developed the means to manipulate and harness this energy by "burning" it and causing it too explode. Burning one's Cosmo enables a being to perform extraordinary feats including pulverizing rocks with their bare hands, striking faster than the speed of sound, throwing hundreds (or even thousands to millions) of blows in a second. Beings such as Saints, whom are one of many beings that use the power of Cosmo, are humans who have been trained to awaken and attune to their Cosmo. Comparatively, even the weakest Saint can outclass even the strongest of human warrior through the awakening of their Cosmo. As the power Cosmo grows in an individual, it becomes necessary for a being to practice controlling their abilities and powers.

These are the basic abilities that all Cosmo users will have;

• Matter Manipulation: The power of Cosmo can cause destruction of matter at the atomic level which is used to power all attacks, and abilities.

•Heat Manipulation: Cosmo will radiate out from a Cosmo user. In addition to, when burning one's own Cosmo it causes intense heat to flare up around the user burning anything in a small radius around them. Cosmo-based attacks are imbued with intense heat

•Rage Power: The Power, and Potency of Cosmo is increased with rage, allowing characters to even briefly contend with stronger opponents even if briefly

•Superhuman Physical Characteristics: The usage of Cosmo allows for superhuman powers. (strength, speed, durability, stamina, reflexes, etc)

Energy Manipulation: Cosmo-based attacks are imbued with energy which increases power, and other stats.

•Enhanced Senses: By sensing Cosmo, they are capable of tracking events taking place over a large distance. Also the main five senses are enhanced, as they can hear from great distances, have enhanced eyesight to zoom in and see things, enhanced sense of smell, also enhanced taste and touch.

Durability Negation: Through the destruction of Atoms.

(Basic Resistances)

These are the resistances that a Basice level Cosmo User would have;

•Matter Manipulation: Every attack, and ability, from a Cosmo user is imbued with the power of "Cosmo." Therefore even basic users take attacks from each other. If a Cosmos user fights a non-Cosmos user, the atoms of the non Cosmos user will be destroyed by a simple strike as it targets its atoms.

•Cold Energy Manipulation: Bronze cloths freeze at a temperature of -240 degrees F, while Silver Saint Cloths freeze at a temperature of -330 Degrees F. By flaring their Cosmo they can increase their resistance further against cold temperatures.

•Electricity Manipulation: Basic Cosmo Users can withstand 10,000 volts of electricity for a short period of time. 

•Temperature Manipulation: Cosmo Users Generate heat in their attacks, and surroundings, and all attacks are imbued with Cosmo. Thus when fighting each other they are also taking attacks imbued with intense heat.

•Sealing: A Cosmo user can resist being Sealed

entries.name: 6th Sense
entries.content:
The 6th Sense is the source of all psychic phenomenon. Those who have developed this Sense a great deal are called, "Psychics." This Sense is often referred to as the domain of consciousness or "The Mind." 6th Sense users have a strongly developed sense of "Instinct." This gives them an idea of Danger, but not much other details about it. Sometimes, they even have vague "dreams" of danger instead of feeling it by instinct. Low tier users like the Bronze Saints can move at Mach 1 (343 m/s), High Tier users such as the Silver Saints are 100 times more stronger than a Bronze Saint and move between Mach 2 and Mach 5 (686 to 1715 m/s)

The Powers that the 6th Sense brings are:

•Extrasensory Perception: By virtue of having the 6th sense. This sense gives them vague details of danger, and can also allow them to know the direction of it for further action to be taken.

•Precognition: The 6th Sense will tell the user that there is danger, and tell them in what direction it will come from along with how to react to it.

•Teleportation: Teleportation is stated to be a Psychic Ability.

•Sealing: Higher Tier Psychics are able to seal movements.

•Paralysis Inducement: Higher Tier Psychic Users can paralyze targets with their psychic abilities.

•Telekinesis, and Flight: Intermediate Tier psychic's can use telekinesis on beings, and objects in other dimensions,and they can use their Telekinesis to levitate in the air mimicking flight.

•Telepathy: 6th Sense can communicate from one mind to another as long as they are within close proximity to each other. Powerful psychics can use Cross-Dimensional Telepathy which can intercept prayers.

entries.name: 7th Sense
entries.content:
The 7th Sense lies even deeper in all living beings than the five basic senses and the sixth sense. In the Mythological times, all living beings were aware of it, and used the 7th sense, but as time went on. This ability has been lost. With the 7th Sense, a being is able to draw out the true potential of their Cosmo and achieve exceptionally powerful feats far beyond those of even a normal Cosmo User, like wielding a power destructive that ranges from shattering Stars to disintegrate a The Milky-Way Galaxy, and reach speeds faster than light, or being able to punch millions of times per second. Typically, Gold Saints are the most prominent examples of beings fully aware of their Seventh Sense enough to harness it adequately; though there are those who are talented, despite being lower in rank, are capable of the same feat, allowing them to fight on par with, and if sufficiently skilled enough they could overcome a Gold Saint. 7th Sense user can reach the speed of light (300,000 km/s)

A 7th Sense User will have all the abilities of an ordinary Cosmo User with some improvements to a few, in addition to these new abilities;

•Improved Passive Extrasensory Perception: These users have an additional sense beyond the 6th known as "The 7th Sense." 

•Improved Passive Enhanced Senses: These users have improved sensing capabilities. For Example, an Aries Saint was able to easily locate a Virgo Saint who was in realm beyond the universe , and The Vigo Saint was able to easily locate his home Universe.

•Forcefield Creation: These users can generate a shield made from pure Cosmo around them at the start of battle

•Limited Self-Healing: These users are healed upon using the 7th Sense. Example someone who was calcules to be recovered in 6 months recovered in just one month.

(7th Sense Users Resistances)

These are the resistances a 7th Sense User will have along with all previous resistances.

•Improved resistance to Temperature Manipulation: All attacks are imbued with the power of Cosmo and as such they have taken many attacks from other Cosmo users of this level.

•Improved resistance to Cold Energy Manipulation: Gold cloths, and 7th Sense Users, freeze at -459 degrees Fahrenheit. This resistance can be extended further by raising their Cosmo.

•Improved resistance to Electricity Manipulation: 7th Sense users have tanked bolts of lightening.

•Improved resistance to Sense Manipulation and Perception Manipulation: By having a higher sense beyond the 5 basic senses and the 6th sense. This sense was known as the "7th Sense."

entries.name: 8th Sense
entries.content:
While the Seventh Sense pertains to the Cosmos of living beings, there exists a Cosmo affiliated with the soul and of the supernatural. This is the "Eighth Sense". This extraordinary sense is associated with the soul of the deceased and functions in the same manner as the Seventh Sense of the living. Also known as "Arayashiki" (meaning "source" or "storehouse" in Buddhism), this is a level of human consciousness that defies all rationale and logic. As an individual becomes a soul upon death, they lose their connection to their Seventh Sense which is replaced with a special "Eighth" Sense. These will be the abilities any 8th sense User will have along with all previous abilities;

•Improved Passive Extrasensory Perception: With the "8th Sense"which exist beyond the five basic senses, the sixth, and even the seventh Sense.
8th Sense Users Resistances

These are the resistance all 8th sense users would have along with all previously mentioned resistances.

•BFR: A 8th Sense User Virgo Saint was unaffected by the Gemini Saints "Another Dimension, and was unaffected by his own "Rikudō Rinne."

•Law Manipulation: 8th Sense users can enter to restricted areas as well to ignore the laws imposed by the gods.

•Life and Death Manipulation: 8th Sense Users can enter to the underworld of Hades. Who any living begin who enters there automatically dies, so tte 8th Sense is what keeps the user “alive” (In the sense that it maintains Its counciouness and personality)

entries.name: 9th Sense
entries.content:
This highest known point of Cosmo for Humans currently in the franchise with it being almost exclusive to Gods. It exists even deeper in oneself even further beyond the 8th Sense. Few humans have reached the 9th Sense. Not much is known about it, other than it allows the user to use the power of Dunamis, and is a higher state of being than the 8th Sense.

This is the list of abilities 9th Sense Users who are Humans will get, in addition to all other previous abilities mentioned before:

•Improved Passive Extrasensory Perception: Via having an additional sense called “The 9th Sense.”

•Void Manipulation: The 9th Sense when mastered allows a character to use Dunamis which is the power of the void.

•Spatial Manipulation: Dunamis causes the expansion of the Universe.

•Deconstruction: Dunamis can deconstruct atoms.

•Chaos Manipulation, and Elemental Manipulation: When all elements in the universe are combined together it generates Chaos. The 9th Sense when awakened gives the power to control Chaos.

•Dimensional Travel, through Gravity Manipulation that creates Portals: Dunamis can be used to link two parallel universes together and open a portal that allows for another Earth to pass through

entries.name: The Gods
entries.content:
The Gods of The Saint Seiya Universe are unique in that they have special properties, and powers that no mortal would have. This sets them apart from other characters. They are are higher dimensional begins that exist in a dimension above Humans. To them the speed of light is slow, as they are infinitely faster than it.

The gods also see time differently due to their Misopetamenos. As their heart beats 100,000 times per year instead of per day. Making 1 humans year (12 months) be 1 day for them (24 hours)

Gods or Divine Beings would have all the same abilities a Basic Cosmo User would have, as well as all the same abilities as a 7th, 8th, and 9th Sense Cosmo User would have. In addition to the new these new abilities;

•Passive Perception Manipulation, and Sense Manipulation: By being in the presence of a God; the six senses are rendered unusable and denied. The Sixth Sense is also shut down nullifying its abilities.

•Passive Paralysis Inducement: The power that radiates from the Gods causes the affected targets to become paralyzed, and unable to move.

•Passive Absorption, Life Manipulation, and Statistics Reduction: The source off all powers by humans in the verse is "Cosmo" which will be absorbed in the presence of a god,and which will have their strength, speed, stamina, endurance, and durability reduced too zero, as well as preventing any abilities from being used by being near a God. 

•Passive Mind Manipulation, Empathic Manipulation, and Fear Manipulation: The Gods radiate a divine aura that causes both fear and love in the surrounding beings and forces them to obey the Gods command. In addition to this, all thoughts are "disabled" in the presence of a God due to the 6th Sense being disabled.

•Improved Passive Heat Manipulation: Increases in Cosmo level increases the level of Temperature of attacks, and the area around them, and all the gods have infinite Cosmo thus they reach Infinite heat.

•Passive Attack Reflection: All attacks that are "Cosmo" in nature including attacks that are non-physical are reflected back.

•Improved Passive Extrasensory Perception: By having an additional sense above the sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth senses, known as "The Tenth Sense."

•Improved and thought based Matter Manipulation: The gods can also control all Atoms in the world with their very will.
Immortality: Additionally, the gods can’t die even if their bodies and souls are destroyed, as they go in an state of hyper sleep. This is due that as long their concept exists they shall prevail.

•Thought based Time Manipulation, Curse Manipulation, and Petrification: The Gods can stop time with a thought using their Divine Will which will also turn the target to stone with a curse.

•Reality Warping through Matter Manipulation, and Creation: The Gods can restructure the reality of their universes, and others, through their Divine Will.Each God has a Universe they created, and they can change it with their Divine Will. 

Resistances of The Gods

All previous resistances, in addition too;

•Improved resistance to Sense and Perception Manipulation: They have an additional sense known as the “10th Sense." 

•Improved resistance to Existence Erasure: Their blood, known as “Divine Ichor,” prevents other people from being erased from history.

•Space and Time Manipulation: The Gods are immune to changes in Space, and Time.

•Absolute Zero: The Gods can only be frozen with temperatures hundreds of times colder than Absolute Zero.

entries.name: Saints of Athena
entries.content:
Saints of Athena

The Saints of Athena are warriors dedicated to defending the Goddess Athena, The Earth, and all Humanity. They sacrifice their lives for the greater good of all lives on Earth. They are in total 88 Warriros who wear and special armor called “Cloth”. 

The Cloth are composed of an alloy made of Orichalcum, Ganium and Stardust, is considered the strongest metal in the world that the only way to crack it is to target its atoms. 

The Cloths have two forms, the armor mode and the object form; the object form it’s a totem metallic statue that represents the constellation of a Saint.

The Cloths are stored in big metallic boxes of 1 meter tall called “Pandora Box”. An Pandora Box has straps on one side so the Saint can use it as a backpack. In modern times the Pandora Box can shrink in size of a small pendant. 

Only Saints can access to their respective Pandora Boxes. If someone else tries to open it, the Pandora Box emits a light that blinds the intruder permanently as a security mechanism.

When a Saint wears its Cloth, the attire that possesed before morphs into a jumpsuit as it’s atoms had been transmuted and it’s beneath the armor plates. When the armor has been destroyed or deactivated the jumpsuit morphs back to the previous attire.

They are divided into three ranks, Bronze Saints (52 in total), Silver Saints (24 in Total), and Gold Saints (12 in total). Gold Saints being the strongest of the three. 

The Bronze Saints and Silver Saints are basic Cosmo users. Therefore, they would have all the abilities of a basic user ie only the 6th Sense. The Gold Saints have the 7th sense, and have complete mastery over the power of Cosmo. They have a full understanding of the power of "Cosmo." Therefore, they would have all the abilities of a 7th Sense user. 

Bronze Saints move at Mach 1 (343 m/s)

Silver Saints reach Mach 2 to Mach 5 speeds (686 m/s to 1715 m/s) and One Silver Saint is 100 times stronger than a Bronze.

Gold Saint reach the speed of light (300,000,000 m/s)

Their leader is the Pope of the Sanctuary, who is also the right hand figure to the goddess Athena

The Saints of Athena would have these additional abilities;

•Passive Accelerated Development: A saints' skill, speed, and power will continue to improve throughout a fight, and they continue to get stronger every time they are "knocked down." Eventually even surpassing the power of the 12 Gold Saints.Another example, is the that a Silver Saint was 100 times stronger than a Bronze Saint. However, in only a couple of minutes said Bronze Saint closed this gap. Others Bronze Saints went from Bronze saint level to a level that surpasses even Silver Saints.
•Passive Supernatural Willpower and Instinctive Reaction: A Saint will continue to fight even when unconscious.

•Passive Sight Based Reactive Evolution: The Saints of Athena are capable of adapting to many situations during their fights to gain an advantage after seeing their opponents moves, and abilities. The same technique will not work twice on a Saint.

•Martial Arts, and Unconventional Pressure Points: The Saints are trained in all martial arts, and are taught too easily identify the weak points of the human body which can also be used to incapacitate a person. In the world of Saint Seiya the saints have additional pressure points that take the shape of their guardian constellation upon their body. These are called "Star life points."

•Summoning: Saints can summon their Pandora Boxes and they open to reveal the Cloth on its object form.

entries.name: Miracle Power
entries.content:
The power of miracles stems from the Infinite Potential, and Infinite Cosmo hidden deep inside of humans which can be temporarily drawn out. This grants them temporary abilities that allows them to change their fate, warp reality, and increase their stats beyond that of a Gods. This power is specifically drawn out during dire moments when a character displays immense amount of Courage, or Hope when against a character they could not defeat. This power can also arise in moments of "kinship" between friends.

•Improved Supernatural Willpower, and Mind Manipulation Negation: Mortal Willpower is infinite, and the human will has no limits. The strength of ones Cosmo is closely related to a characters "Will."

•Passive Fate Manipulation, and Fate Manipulation negation, along with Statistics Amplification: Miracles allow a character to temporarily draw out power from their infinite Will,and thus subsequently this increases all of their physical stats due tot he relationship Cosmo has with physical stats such as speed, stamina, durability, and potency. This power also reshapes, and changes, the fate forced upon humans by the gods allowing them to overcome a situation, or adversary they normally cannot defeat.

entries.name: Divine Blood
entries.content:
This is the blood that flows in the veins of the Gods. Receiving the blood of a god is a divine honor. If someone is splashed with the blood of a god it will grant them many abilities such as;

•Acausality: (Type 1) Those splashed with the blood of a god are immune to changes to their "history."

•Healing: All Wounds are healed after having the blood splashed upon them, and their stamina completely restored.
Resistances granted by receiving Divine Ichor

Being given the blood of a God also helps resist certain abilities.

•Spatial Manipulation and Time Manipulation: Those who received the divine ichor were immune to changes in The Super Dimensional Space. Where time and space were in flux and never consistent.

•Curse Manipulation, and Void Manipulation Negation along with negation of Immortality and BFR: Hades Sword curses the soul's of beings cut with it and removes them from the cycle of samsara moving them into a world of nothingness, but Athena’s blood prevents the removal.

•Law Manipulation, and Death Manipulation: Those who received the blood of Athena can enter the Underworld without consequence of Hades Law’s, or suffer from instantly dying upon going into the Underworld. 

•Status Effect Inducement: The stats for those splashed with the Divine Ichor of a God cannot be lowered.

(Divine Armors)
The Divine Armors are a special type of armor that happens to be, so far, the "ultimate evolution" of armor, which occurs by receiving the blood of a god and the wearer having their cosmo burn high enough to "awaken" it. And that once the battle is over they return to their previous state.

They are known as the highest rank among armors since they are the closest to the Kamui, which are worn only by the 12 Olympian gods.

The power they display is so great that they can surpass and match Gods themsleves, as the wearer of a Divine Armor are powerful enough to resist and damage them.

These armors provide many incredible abilities such as being able to withstand the pressure generated by The Way of the Gods or Súper Dimensional Space, and even being able to fly as well as other armors restore the wearer's power and heal him from any previous injuries he may have suffered.
Conditions

To access such armor must be bathed with the blood of a God, the cosmos must rise to the limits, even achieving that a armor destroyed in its entirety is reborn from its remains attached to the body of the wearer.

The users of a Divine Armor are infinitely stronger than the Strongest Warriors of each armada such as the Gold Saints of Athena, Judges of Hades, Mariner Generals of Poseidon, etc. only a god is needed to match it.

entries.name: The Sanctuary
entries.content:
The Sanctuary is the base of operations of the Saints of Athena and at the same time is the place from where the goddess herself exercises her functions as protector of the mortal world. It is the place of training of several aspiring Saints, and within it stand out the constructions of the Colosseum, the Twelve Houses guarded by the Golden Saints, the Pope's Chamber, the room of the goddess Athena, the Statue of Athena, Star Hill, the Clock of Fire, among others.

It’s located nearby Athens, Greece however it’s separated of society. 

Athena, the daughter of Zeus, the supreme god of Olympus, 
Gave her control of the Planet Earth. Since time immemorial, Athena has faced other gods who have wanted to take over the Earth. Among them, for example, have been Poseidon, Ares and Hades. The clashes between gods are known as Holy Wars. The first Holy War was waged against Poseidon (which was known as the big Flooding) To confront him, Athena summoned a group of young and brave warriors, whom she called Saints. At first, they fought without weapons or protection for their bodies. Because of this, many were killed by Poseidon's generals. To help them, Athena created 88 sacred Cloth, inspired by the constellations. With these armors, the Saints were able to defeat Poseidon's Generals.

This Sanctuary had a hierarchical structure, led by the goddess and followed by the Pope or High Priest, who in turn led the 88 Saints. The Temple of Athena was located in the center of the Sanctuary and its only entrance was the Pope's chamber. In turn, to reach the Pope's chamber, the only way available was to go through the Twelve Houses (Temples), each of which was guarded by a Gold Saint. Teleportation is not allowed neither is flying as the Sanctuary is enveloped by Athena’s Cosmos so is hard to move around and the only path is trough the 12 Zodiac Temples.

•The 12 Temples: The 12 temples are connected by long stairways carved into the rocks and flanked by stone columns. Each is erected on a higher plane than the previous one along the mountain slope. Gold Saints can usually move through the houses guarded by their companions, but it is customary to ask permission from the owner of a house being crossed out of simple courtesy.

In wartime, this place is the last defensive perimeter that intruders must cross, the twelve temples guarded by the Gold Saints and over which an invisible barrier created with Athena's cosmo prevents invaders from teleporting between the temples so that the only way to advance through the temples is by walking. The order is: Aries>Taurus>Gemini>Cancer>Leo>Virgo>Libra>Scorpio>Sagittarius>Capricorn>Aquarius>Pisces. Ending in the Chambers of the Pope and the altair of Athena.

However is not as easy as between the Pisces Temple and the Cambers of gge Pope, the path way is covered of posionous Roses during time of war. When it’s not time of war, the Pathway is free.

•The Chambers of the Pope: The last temple on top of the Sanctuary. Where there lies Both the Pope of the Sanctuary and Athena herself. It’s a Two stories temple as inside there is a throne room and a shower chamber do the Pope Can take baths to purify itself. Behind the throne room lies a curtain that leads to the backyard of the temple, whwre lies the enourmous statue of Athena.

•Athena’s Statue: It’s a large statue that symbolizes the Goddess of Wisdom. The statue holds Nike in it’s right hand and the shield Aegis on it’s left hand. When splashed with divine Blood the statue shrinks of size of a doll as it’s the Cloth of Athena, as only her she can wear it. Only the Pope knows this classified information.

•The Colliseum: where the Trainees prove themsleves to Sainthood by winning against their opponent. 

•The Clock Tower: In another part, Next to the 12 houses and located in the heart of the Sanctuary, rises the gigantic Meridia or tower of the zodiacal clock, a huge prismatic pillar, very high (approximately 50 meters) and quadrangular in shape. It is the most prominent structure in the precinct after the colossal statue of Athena. This solar tower functions as a zodiac clock, marks the hours and is adorned with representations of the 12 signs of the Zodiac in its highest part. On it are sculpted four circular quadrants oriented towards the four cardinal points. Each solar quadrant is divided into twelve sections corresponding to the twelve zodiacal symbols and 12 flames burn in each quadrant, each flame representing the hour of each sign. The gigantic zodiacal clock is visible from any point of the Sanctuary, from all the houses of the Zodiac, the Pope's Palace and the altar of Athena. A true monument of art whose exact location cannot be determined.

•Star Hill: Next to the Sanctuary there is a mountain rises a second rock formation, higher and thinner than the previous one, the so-called Star Hill, which is considered the closest place to heaven. It is a rocky peak, very high vertically, on whose summit, difficult to access because of the steepness of the slope, stands, completely isolated, the tiny temple of prayers, a church with the appearance of a small cathedral or celestial observatory. It is furnished inside and filled with books and manuscripts. This mountain is the sacred mountain where the successive Popes make their predictions by observing the movement of the stars, which allows them to foretell the future of the world. This place is not far from the 12 houses and is described as the most sacred of all the Sanctuary: even a Gold Saint needs special permission to penetrate it.

•Cape Sounion: 
Cape Sunion is a rocky crag where the ruins of a temple in honor of Poseidon are located and at its base, where it flows into the sea, there is a dungeon used by Athena's army as a prison for traitors and prisoners. At the base of the cape is a prison from which it is said that no one can escape with human strength. Being located at sea level, every time the tide rises, the stone prison is usually completely filled with seawater for 10 days.

•Rodorio Village: Outisde of the Sanctuary there’s a Village called Rodorio, in honor of the Pegasus Saint of the age of myth. its inhabitants are aware of the existence of the Pope of the Sanctuary and the order of the Saints of Athena in general, but they do not seem to be able to visit the Sanctuary itself. They are familiar and accustomed to receiving occasional visits from the Pope, whom they appreciate very much, as he consoles and comforts them, or comes to heal some sick or wounded, or from some Gold Saint who was highly valued by the villagers for his strength and kindness. The lifestyle is rural.

entries.name: Underworld
entries.content:
The Underworld is the world where the souls of the living go after death, whose ruler is Hades, the King of the Underworld. Souls upon arriving in this world, must cross the Infernal Gate and the Sanzu River, after crossing, they must wait in the First Prison to be judged by an Infernal Leader for their sins, and depending on these, according to the book, they will be assigned one of eight prisons. The dead are tortured for eternity. For a soul to move with its own will, it needs to awaken the Arayashiki (8th sense), otherwise it is trapped under the laws imposed by the power of Hades to this world. It is a world created by the power of Hades and when the god was destroyed by Athena, the world disappeared along with Hades.


•Infernal Gate: The Infernal Gate is a structure located at the beginning of the Underworld, it fulfills the function of giving message to the arriving souls, the message is located at the top of the gate, written in Greek, it says the following:  “ΟΠΟΙΟΣ ΜΠΑΙΝΕΙ ΕΔΩ ΝΑ ΠΑΡΑΤΑ ΚΑΘΕ ΕΛΠΙΔΑ”
(Abandon all hope those who enter here)

•The Sanzu River: The Sanzu River is the first river to be seen after crossing the Infernal Gate, the Specter Acheron of the Celestial Star of Space takes souls to the First Prison on his raft (because it is the only thing that can float on the river) in exchange for obols (ancient Greek currency) or valuables, those who remain on the banks of the river eternally, fall into deep despair, some try to cross the river, sinking and lamenting at the bottom of the river for all eternity.

•The First Prison: The First Prison is a silent palace where judgments are carried out on souls according to the sins committed in life as seen from the book by the Judge of the Underworld, the Griffon Specter. If the Judge is absent, the Balrog Specter, it’s right hand, takes over.

•Valley of the Dark Gale: The Valley of the Dark Gale is a bridge that connects the Second Prison with the First. When the defendant crosses this valley, an extremely strong wind begins to circulate, falling into the void for all eternity.

•The Second Prison: The Second Prison is a palace of Egyptian architecture in ruins, inside is rubble and there is intense darkness. Here the misers are sent where they are punished with freezing rain and if they fail, they are hunted by the dog Cerberus.

•Field of flowers: The Flower Field is the only place where there is life in the entire Underworld.

•The Third Prison: The Third Prison is a grotto with a dirt path flanked by two high rock walls. The mean and wasteful are punished in this prison, condemned to give stones eternally as weight for their sins.

•The Fourth Prison: The Fourth Prison is a large valley where there is a swamp, in this prison the darkness is dense, its function is to punish those who suffered from anger and desolation.

•The Fifth Prison: The Fifth Prison is a terrain of small mountains of darkened rock and covered with tombs made of stone blocks where those who have not complied with divine teachings will suffer forever in the burning tombs.

•Sixth Prison: The Sixth Prison is made up of three valleys.

First Valley: The First Valley is a pool of boiling blood, where souls are punished for being violent or arbitrarily using their power against others.

Second Valley: The Second Valley is a hellish forest where suicides are eternally punished for not appreciating their lives.

Third Valley: The Third Valley is a desert with extreme temperatures, where souls are punished for committing rape.

•Great Bloodfall: The Great Bloodfall is a stretch where blood falls. The blood feeds on the tears of the souls that lie in the Underworld.

•Underworld Willow: In the Underworld there is a Willow that feeds on blood from the great waterfall. It is one of the few life forms that exist in the Underworld and owes its existence to the Eighth Sense. This tree produces fruits whose minerals are opposite to the Surplices, these fruits can capture the souls of those protected by the Surplices.

Seventh Prison: The Seventh Prison is the largest infernal prison of all. It is here that people guilty of fraud, theft or corruption are burned by boiling pitch.

First Malebolge: The First Malebolge is the bolgia where souls are punished for pimps by being whipped.

Second Malebolge: The Second Malebolge is the bolgia where souls are punished for flattering, they are covered with blood.

Third Malebolge: The Third Malebolge is the bolgia where the souls fall due to simoniac, they are hung upside down.

Malebolge Room: The Malebolge Room this bolgia is where souls fall for performing divinations, they are punished by turning their heads 180° degrees.

Fifth Malebolge: The Fifth Malebolge (is the bolgia where souls fall for being embezzlers in life, they are tormented by demons while suffering in boiling tar.

Sixth Malebolge: The Sixth Malebolge is the bolgia where souls fall for being hypocrites in life, they are punished by wearing heavy lead mantles.

7th Malebolge: The Seventh Malebolge this is the bolgia where souls fall for being thieves, they are punished by being thrown into a nest of snakes.

8th Malebolge: The Eighth Malebolge this is the bolgia where souls fall for being malicious advisors, they are burned in a hell of flames.

Ninth Malebolge: The Ninth Malebolge is the bolgia where souls fall for inciting discord, they are punished by being torn to pieces.

10th Malebolge: The Tenth Malebolge is the bolgia where souls fall for forgers, the dead pull their hair and scratch themselves with their rotting bodies full of mold.

• Eighth Prison: Cocytus: The Eighth Prison aka The Cocytus is where the souls are punished for blasphemy and conspiracy against the Gods, it is a great desert of ice where the souls are sunk in the sky, leaving only their faces uncovered, where a strong blizzard circulates and whips them in the face for all eternity. This prison is where most of the Saints end up after their death, since they are warriors of the Goddess Athena, they arrive here automathically when they die.

•The First Sphere: Caina: This is the first sphere in the frozen hell of the Cocytus, this temple belongs to the Wyvern Specter. It is a temple or mansion, possibly home to the Specter, a quadrangular-shaped building with 4 rounded columns at each end, small stairs surround the entire structure, both the columns and the central part of the building have domes adorned with statues of the mythological Wyvern in the which the Surplice is based on.

•Second Sphere: Antenora: Is the second sphere in the ice hell, this temple belongs to the Garuda Specter. The temple has a polygonal base on which rises a circular building whose circumference has columns interspersed by two walls, supporting the wide and flat roof from which emerge another set of columns arranged in a circle, from which a roof emerges again but this time holding the figure of the Garuda Specter, the animal on which the Surplice is based.

•Third Sphere: Ptolemy: It’s the third sphere of the Cocytus, its guardian is Griffon Specter. The temple is located on top of a high stone base that is accessed by stairs, on its sides there are two statues of Griffins with their wings open. The building is surrounded by columns that support the roof, which is gabled in its central part and particularly smooth on its sides.

•Fourth Sphere: Guidecca: This is the last palace in Hell, it is where the throne of Hades is located and where Pandora gives orders to the Specters. Behind the throne of Hades is a dark curtain where the Wailing Wall is located.

•The Wailing Wall: Is behind the throne of Hades, it is a wall of great width and height, where the faces of Hypnos and Thanatos are carved. This wall is almost indestructible, and cannot be crossed except by a god. The power of the sun is required to be able to pierce it, which is not possible in the Underworld since sunlight does not reach it; only the twelve Gold Cloths have this power.

Behind the wall is the Hyper Dimension/Super Dimensional Space, a strange dimensional space that only gods or mortals who have divine protection can cross. There it leads to a pathway to the Elysium Fields

•The Elysium Fields: The Elysion is a utopian place dominated by Hades that is located beyond the Underworld and where only gods and mortals who have been chosen by the gods who rule the world of the dead or who have not committed any sin in life can go. . It is described as Paradise because it is a place free from all suffering and worldly desires. It is a world created by the power of Hades, although it has a different temporal axis, so time passes differently.
In the Elysium is where the True Body of Hades lies on its own temple, also this is where Thanatos, Hypnos and Kerr also live.

entries.name: Specters
entries.content:
The Specters are the 108 warriors that make up the army of the god Hades. Those who are part of this army were ordinary human beings who lived on Earth and were chosen by the Evil Stars when they freed themselves from the seal imposed by Athena. In this way, they are given the knowledge and skills necessary to fight for Hades in the Holy War against Athena and her army. However, Hades and figures of great authority within this army, such as Pandora, can freely choose who they will incorporate into their ranks. Therefore, they can offer a warrior from another god's army to join them and, if he accepts, swearing allegiance to Hades, he will become part of the 108 Specters.

Some of the Specters perform additional functions outside of the battlefield, such as transporting souls through the Underworld or judging them to determine their punishment according to their sins. Furthermore, it is common to see several of them guarding and monitoring different areas of the Underworld, as well as Hades' territory on Earth.

•Surplice: It is the armor that the Specters wear. It’s apperance it’s of a dark purple armor and beneath it a black sleeveless jumpsuit or black leotard for the females. Only those who swear allegiance to Hades can wear it.

•Evil Stars: They are the Evil Stars that represent the 108 warriors that are part of the army of Hades, these stars are divided into Celestial and Terrestrial. Having been sealed in the last Holy War by Athena, they return once again to choose the person who will carry that star and the Surplice that corresponds to it, in this way they are chosen as warriors at the service of Hades.

•Commander of the Specters: After Pandora fullfiled her duty unwittingly in opening the box that released the Evils within it, she was given to Hades so she would become his commander. The Commander is in charge of guarding Hades after his soul descends to the underworld and leading the Specters during the Holy War.

•The Three Judges of the Underworld: The three of them are the most powerful Specters in the service of Hades. Each one commands a group of Specters, which are considered their subordinates. It’s said that Each Judge is stronger than the Gold Saints the Athena, including the Gemini Saints (who can destroy a Galaxy). The Judges are these Specters; Wyvern, Griffon, Garuda

•Skeleton Foot Soldiers: They are the lowest ranking warriors in the service of Hades. They all wear Skeleton's Surplice and are armed with a scythe. Their main function is to monitor Hades' territory on Earth and some areas of the Underworld, although on occasion they have also been seen acting as Pandora's messengers.

•Revived Warriors: Hades and those who have the god's permission can raise the dead. An ability they have used to bring back the Saints of Athena or another warrior from another faction, to fight on their behalf, wearing a Surplice with the appearance of the Cloth or armor they wore in their past life.

The Specters of Hades are also Cosmo Users. They would have all the abilities as the Specters have the 6th sense and are strong as a Silver Saint, while the Judges and a few posses the 7th Sense Users, they have in addition too;

These are the soldiers of Hades. They were granted abilities, and powers by Hades in exchange for eternal life.

•Immortality and Regeneration: The Specters of Hades are filled with the Divine Will of Hades. They will continue to regenerate long as the Will of Hades remains within them. Additionally; the Specters of Hades are already dead by default, and they do not possess a concept of death.As a specter serving Hades, Aspros, regenerated from being a fetus, and another specter came back from being turned to a speck of Dust. The only way they could die is by making a breaded Rosary of 108 spheres that could contain their souls.

•Acausality: Specters are are unaffected by the flow of time

•Main God
Hades: Hades is the god who controls the Underworld and the dead; son of Kronos and Rhea. Feeling disappointed with humans since the mythological era, he began a series of crusades against Athena to punish humans who have polluted the world with their existence. He descended to the underworld to occupy his yorishiro and execute the "Greatest Eclipse", with the purpose of punishing and ending the lives of humans inhabiting Earth. He has his original body stored in Elysium, so he uses vessels in his place. The requirement is to be the purest human being of that time.

  •Minor  Gods
They are brother gods who agreed to serve Hades. They reside in Elysion with their true bodies and function as advisors to the King of the Underworld since the mythological era.

Hypnos: He is the god of the Underworld who controls sleep, and is the twin brother of Thanatos. Together they are the advisors of Hades since the mythological era. He does not like to fight so as not to dirty his surroundings so he puts his victims in an eternal sleep.

Thanatos: He is the god of the Underworld who controls death, and is the twin brother of Hypnos. Together they are the advisors of Hades since the mythological era. Unlike Hypnos, Thanatos is more ruthless and cruel.


Kerr: She is the goddess of the Underworld who controls destiny, and is the sister of Hypnos and Thanatos.

entries.name: The Lost Canvas
entries.content:
Note: This is exclusive for the 18th century era.

•The Lost Canvas: The Lost Canvas is a painting made by Alone (Hades’ Vessel in the 18th Century)with which he tries to destroy humanity by giving him true salvation without the suffering of being condemned to the Underworld after death, the painting is found in the sky covering the clouds. Each person who is painted is separated from his soul, therefore it dies, but his soul, instead of going to the Underworld, goes directly to the painting, becoming "part of it." 

Inside of the Lost Canvas, lies the Sanctuary of Alone that he made using the power of Hades. The Evil Temples.

•Evil Temple: Alone built the Evil Temples to which he assigned a guardian. Those chosen to guard the Temples were Specters who swore allegiance to Alone, and two resurrected warriors who betrayed Athena. The Temple of Pluto did not have a designated guardian, as it was the place where Alone intended to lock himself with Hades' soul after completing his objective. At the beginning of the temples, there is a large wall that can only be broken through the Athena Exclamation (A combined Attack that needs 3 Gold Saints focusing their blast in a single point). Then, a kind of sea made of clouds; After passing this, you will find temples or houses whose organization is like the Solar System.

Each Temple have their own guardian.
Evil Temple Guardian
Mercury: Mephistopheles Yoma
Venus: Barlog Lune
Earth: Bennu Kagaho
Mars: Gemini Aspros
Jupiter:  Harpy Valentine
Saturn: Wyvern Rhadamanthys
Uranus: Owl Partita
Neptune: None
Pluto: Alone
